senses.gloss: (transpos. of סִפְסֵף; cmp. גִּעְגֵּעַ) to cut the ends, trim by singeing.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 5:10">Tosef. Pes. V, 10</cite> <he>אין … אבל מְפַסְפְּסִין אותן באור</he> you dare not scald the head and feet (of the Passover lamb) …, but you may trim them by holding them over the fire; <cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 3:19">Tosef. Bets. III, 19</cite> (Var. <he>מספסין</he>; <cite ref="Beitzah 34a:9">Bets. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>מהבהבין</he>). Y. ib. IV, 62ᶜ bot. <he>אין מפספסין</he> quot. in Levy (ed. Krot. <he>מספספ׳</he>), v. <cite ref="O01399"><he>סִפְסֵף</he></cite>.
